title: Edit repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/orphaned-capability-scan.ts. This is ONE string replacement of a single line
description:
Edit repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/orphaned-capability-scan.ts. This is ONE string replacement of a single line. Use the exact strings below; do not re-derive your own anchor.

old_string (this exact line, which occurs exactly once in the file):
  const emit = pointer.emit_gaps !== false;

new_string (four lines replacing that one):
  const emit =
    pointer.emit_gaps !== false &&
    (pointer as { emit_gap?: boolean }).emit_gap !== false &&
    (pointer as { dry_run?: boolean }).dry_run !== true;

Nothing else in the file changes. The `emit` constant is already consumed further down, so this adds no unreferenced symbol. The two inline casts are deliberate: they let the resolver honour these caller options without editing the OrphanedCapabilityScanPointer interface, keeping this a single-line-anchored change. This has been verified to typecheck cleanly (`bun run typecheck`, no errors) with the patch applied to a copy of the vessel.

THE DEFECT: this resolver emits gaps BY DEFAULT and has no dry_run at all. The gate reads `pointer.emit_gaps !== false`, so any caller that does not pass the exact plural spelling gets writes. A caller passing the singular `emit_gap: false`, or `dry_run: true`, is silently ignored and the scan writes anyway, with no error and no warning. OBSERVED 2026-08-28T05:12Z: a read-only audit probe that passed `dry_run: true` and `emit_gap: false` re-upserted 40 orphaned_capability gaps, refreshing their detected_at to the probe time. No gaps were created — the ids are stable and the upsert is idempotent — but 40 long-dormant gaps (first detected 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-21) were made to look freshly detected, which misleads any consumer that reasons about recency. Sibling scan resolvers in this vessel honour dry_run; this one is the outlier. Note the fleet is inconsistent here in both directions: trace-outcome-validity-audit.ts gates on the SINGULAR `pointer.emit_gap !== false`. Accepting both spellings plus dry_run is what makes the option mean what a caller intends.

AFTER THIS CHANGE the acceptance test is: snapshot the count of orphaned_capability gaps, resolve orphaned_capability_scan with dry_run:true, then re-count — the count and every detected_at must be unchanged.

Do NOT modify the OrphanedCapabilityScanPointer interface, the emitUrl or apiKey lines above, templateLimit or maxEmit below, or any other function in this file.
